{{Quote|He would have seen no honor in fighting a woman who uses words and tricks to turn a battle.|Akaavi Spar on her father|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Akaavi Spar]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. By the time of the [[Galactic War]] he had passed away,<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" /> and Akaavi was the last remaining member of [[Clan Spar]].<ref name="TOR:AS">{{TORcite|type=codex|Akaavi Spar}}</ref> She mentioned her father in conversations with the [[Voidhound]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
